Add automated release workflow (#1748)

* Add automated release workflow

Triggered on semver tag push. Handles npm publish,
GitHub Release with binaries, .deb build+sign, and
PPA upload to Cloudflare R2. Includes workflow_dispatch
with dry-run mode for safe testing.

* Ignore all GitHub workflows in yamllint

* Pass GPG secrets via env vars instead of inline expansion

* Use npm trusted publishing instead of NPM_TOKEN

* Set version in package.json and index.ts from tag

* Use 0.0.0 placeholder for version in package.json and index.ts

* Use rclone copy instead of sync to never delete R2 files

Support GitLab ANSI section markers (#1740)

* feat: support GitLab ANSI section markers with timing

Parse section_start/section_end ANSI escape sequences in job output
and display human-readable section boundaries with duration.

Closes #1703

* fix: stabilize extra-host test by removing external network dependency

Replace curl HTTP request against a stale Google IP with getent hosts,
which only checks DNS resolution and needs no network connectivity.

* fix: avoid regex backtracking in section marker pattern

Use [^\s\[] instead of \S+? to eliminate ambiguity with the
optional [...] group, preventing super-linear backtracking.

* feat: use cyanBright #section_name markers instead of verbose section text

* fix: use RegExp.exec() instead of String.match() for sonarcloud

* fix: measure actual wall-clock time for section duration instead of embedded timestamps

* fix: use magenta for section duration and remove # prefix

* fix: account for ANSI color codes in section duration regex

fix: unflake services and dependency-proxy tests (#1747)

Mock docker login rejection in dependency-proxy test to avoid
reliance on actual Docker behavior, and increase timeout for
multiport-job test which can exceed 60s in CI.
